title: Ion Flight
tagline: A linear time-of-flight mass spectrometer you can slow down, pulse, and read
card_blurb: Launch ion packets through an ideal linear TOF mass spectrometer. See mass-to-charge separation, coincident arrivals, and why timing width sets the resolution limit.
description: **Ion Flight** — an offline linear TOF mass-spectrometry teaching model. Animate ion packets through a field-free drift tube, read the detector trace, compare equal m/z ions, and test when a longer flight improves resolution. Includes a printable teacher guide.
